info.name: Cyware Orchestrate (CO) Open Custom Email Templates API

params.name: unique_id
params.description: Pass the unique ID of the custom template. You can retrieve the unique ID of a custom email template using the **Get Custom Template List** endpoint.

items.docs: Returns details of a specific custom email template.

params.name: page
params.description: Pass the page number to retrieve the templates list.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Pass the number of items to retrieve per page.

params.name: q
params.description: Pass a value to q to search for custom templates. You can search email templates using the title.

items.docs: Returns the list of custom email templates.
